name: Everlane

prices.note: 26 regular-price, in-stock dresses of 784 listings (551 sold out, 207 marked down). By title: 16 mini, 3 midi, 3 maxi; fabrics include stretch linen, cashmere, fine knit and cotton silk voile. Lowest Weekend Tee Midi Dress $58, highest Cashmere Polo Midi Dress $198.

products.json (3 pages, 542 products): 70 non-jean items (shorts, skirts, jackets, vests, shirts) excluded; 403 had compare_at above price (sale) and were excluded; 69 regular-price women's jeans at $88–$148. Low end: The Way-High Curve Jean ($88, sold in 27" and 29" inseams); high end: W Heavyweight Low Rise Relaxed Boot Flare Jean ($148).

production_model: Partners with ethical factories it audits (fair wages, reasonable hours, environment) and publishes the cost of materials, labor and transport ('Radical Transparency') (About page)
notes: About page footer: 'Clean Luxury. Better For You.'; the page also describes 'Radical Transparency' as revealing 'the true costs behind all of our products.'
US shipping: Standard 4–7 business days $8, Express $20; no free-shipping threshold stated (promotions applied at checkout).
Returns: 30 days from ship date (US and Canada); mail-in returns carry a $7 label fee, in-store returns free.
International page lists the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia among destinations.
Wikipedia: headquartered in San Francisco (move to Los Angeles announced April 2026); founded 2010 by Michael Preysman and Jesse Farmer; Shein agreed to acquire it in May 2026.
